CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_role()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
    SELECT r.name
    FROM public.profiles AS p
    JOIN public.roles AS r ON r.id = p.role_id
    WHERE p.id = (SELECT auth.uid())
      AND p.account_status = 'active';
$function$
